start: ^Keeper: Eh? A visitor. Nobody comes to Gull Point any more.
^Your lamp is out. I can fix it.
looking: ^Keeper: Look all you like. Mind the stairs.
fix: ^Keeper: Fix it? Ha! It needs lamp oil and a flame, and I have neither.
^Keeper: Take my matches, then. The oil can must still be lying on the dock somewhere.
again: ^Keeper: Still here? The lamp will not light itself, you know.
